tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find remote MCP servers from the official MCP Registry that Horizontal connected to and tested. Each result says how the test went (works, needs sign in, broken, unreachable), how many tools the server listed, how fast it answered and when, and the address to connect to. Working servers come first;

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Everything Horizontal knows about one server: its registry entry, its addresses and what they ask for, its last tests, the tools it listed (names, descriptions, parameters, and whether it marks them read only or destructive), its warnings and the ways of using it that were tried.
